name: effect-fence-hold-read-denied-strict-mode
description: HOLD reason `read_denied`. docs/** is in strict mode. Session A reads the artifact (SHARED), then peer session B acquires the write claim via /hooks/pre-edit, which leaves A INVALID with no commit behind it, so the version stays 1 and the ownership generation stays 0. A then fences holding EXACTLY the bytes the coordinator records: the re-validate read is REFUSED (an INVALID session under strict mode), and nothing says its bytes differ. Leg 5 fires on the refusal ALONE. That the leg is unconditional is the point: it once also required an unconfirmed generation, which held only because an in-process strict deny carries no generation -- this route holds the registry's REAL generation, so under the old shape it would have fallen past the leg and mislabelled its hold as generation_unconfirmed. This fixture is the regression guard for exactly that. Fixture 14 is its pair: the same refusal of bytes that are NOT the recorded content answers `split_pair`.
